scope: Correct the confirmed Private Vercel integration consent-entry404 using fixed observed team Dashboard route, without altering owner/state/callback/permission controls.
riskAnalysis: STRICT credential lifecycle and cross-tenant identity risk. Owner session, exact source/release/origin, single-use Redis CAS state, provider identity checks and encrypted authenticated storage are authoritative. Provider scopes remain unconfirmed and broker disabled until genuine consent.

threatModel.assets: Provider tokens, owner and workspace identity, exact deployment and source, audit integrity, existing paid spending controls.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Existing owner dashboard to guarded API, owner-session callback to Redis CAS, fixed provider endpoints to strict validators, encrypted storage to disabled credential broker.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged state or owner, replayed code, cross-workspace callback, foreign installation/project, stale release, provider payload leakage, revocation during exchange, prototype diagnostic substitution.
threatModel.mitigations: Fresh owner policy and CSRF, exact expiring state, atomic consume/audit, finite phase diagnostics, fixed team/project endpoints, AES-GCM tenant AAD, local revocation and disabled agent broker.

rollback: Keep paid execution and all private connections disabled. Revert only C4 application delta and redeploy disabled Preview, preserving original operational journal/evidence/holds and central revocation; never rewrite immutable history or main/Production.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Actual service/API/UI reject malformed envelopes, corrupt task records and fabricated authority; no hidden repairs.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact plan/task revisions, source snapshot and current release guards; UI discards older revisions.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing Redis Lua CAS enforces unique create/claim, fenced completion, and cancellation racing publication.
negativePaths.cancellation: Owner cancellation and internal emergency stop reserve cleanup slots/bytes; original completed evidence remains.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker is launched by OAuth; interrupted callback consumes state once, no automatic retry, local revoke prevents later storage. Already sent provider request cannot be recalled.
negativePaths.api-outage: Redis read/CAS failures deny execution; unknown delivery retains exact scoped idempotency key, no automatic retry.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Preview-only fresh session/member/workspace owner, worker/nonowner/CSRF/Production negatives and workspace-isolated journals.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Private adapters remain inactive without approved broker/gateway wiring, no inference transport or reservation writer added; existing fifteen-dollar ledger and uncertainty preserved.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Original attempt/history preserved, stale fences cannot publish, dependent tasks await verified reports and expired/cancelled work cannot recover.

defects.rootCause: Public provider consent URL was hardcoded although registered integration visibility is Private and provider explicitly requires its team Dashboard entry.
defects.detectionGap: Backend and UI mocks agreed on public URL and validated synthetic callback, not actual Private provider-page availability or state propagation.
defects.regression: Exact observed private-team entry and one fresh state; historical public, foreign team/app, suffix, encoding, duplicatequery rejection; missing/altered/revokedcallback zero transport.
defects.historicalPrevention: Old implementation fails fixed private-entry test before owner dispatch. Actual state propagation remains mandatory hosted evidence, not inferred from fake callback.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse existing workspace-owner policy, guarded Ops API and Redis compare-and-audit; dedicated fixed OAuth callback adds no agent execution route.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing encryption key and Preview Redis; owner must register private integration and enter client secret in scoped Vercel Secret before actual consent.
proactiveReview.threats: Replay, owner loss, state substitution, scope confusion, credential leakage, cross-tenant storage and revoked late-store behavior.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Bounded timeout, finite sanitized phase evidence, no automatic code retry, provider installation may require manual uninstall after unknown delivery.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Only provider transport substituted in real API/runtime composition; actual Redis test covers one atomic callback consumption plus revoke/replay.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Auditor actualdiff review approved guards unchanged; independent QA29/29 and focused37/37 pass. Both require actual original-nonce callback and prohibit nonce repair.
proactiveReview.recovery: Local revoke destroys state/token; subsequent provider boundary and store denied. Provider uninstall is separate; no auto retry or paid authority.
proactiveReview.readiness: Provider private Dashboard/wizard reachable, inspection cancelled and failedstate revoked. New route locallyverified only; real provider state propagation and authentication remain unverified until owner flow.
